meta.description: Run remote NCBI BLAST searches with Biopython, documented program selection, RID polling, and result parsing.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: The inspected source retains citations, explicit reproducibility guidance, and no clinical claim.

practice_boundaries.detail: This is a remote bioinformatics retrieval skill, not diagnostic or patient-facing advice.

methodological_ground.detail: The source distinguishes bit-score from cross-database E-values and specifies the corrected program and short-peptide parameters.

code_usability.detail: Fresh executions of all three shipped Biopython examples and scripts/blast_rid.py reached the NCBI BLAST request path but the BLAST CGI closed each connection without a response. A direct curl to the same CGI reproduced an abrupt server close. Thus fresh live retrieval success cannot be asserted at this audit time.

functional_suitability.note: The documented blastn, blastp, megablast, dc-megablast, RID, and result-parsing routes are present and internally consistent.

reliability.note: RID polling and error states are documented, although current remote execution could not complete against the CGI.

performance_context.note: The Skill explicitly warns that queue latency is variable and distinguishes expensive short-peptide parameters.

agent_usability.note: Program, database, batch-size, and parameter decision boundaries are explicit.

human_usability.note: Failure-mode and Common Errors guidance gives concrete causes and recovery paths.

security.note: No credentials or arbitrary code execution path were found.

maintainability.note: Examples, RID client, and reference files are separated; there is no automated live-test harness.

agent_specific.note: The current source prevents literal program='megablast' misuse and documents local/remote-homology escape hatches.

inputs.label: Current examples/basic_blast.py
inputs.execution_note: Executed the pinned source example from a temporary working directory. It entered NCBIWWW.qblast() and then raised http.client.RemoteDisconnected: Remote end closed connection without response.

inputs.label: Current examples/blastp_filtered.py
inputs.execution_note: Executed the pinned source example from a temporary working directory. Its Swiss-Prot Mammalia request reached NCBIWWW.qblast() and received the same RemoteDisconnected error.

inputs.label: Current short-peptide PAM30 reference block
inputs.execution_note: Executed the literal current references/protein-patterns.md block with a controlled NCBIWWW requester to inspect its call contract: PAM30, word_size=2, gapcosts='9 1', expect=1000, CBS=3, and hitlist_size=100 were all supplied. A fresh live request was not assertable because the CGI was closing connections.

inputs.label: Cross-database E-value decision
inputs.execution_note: Executed current-source textual decision checks for the E=Kmn exp(-lambda S) explanation, database-size warning, and bit-score recommendation; no remote request is required by this reasoning-only input.

inputs.label: Megablast and XML save/reparse paths
inputs.execution_note: Parsed the pinned test_results.xml through current source functions (33 alignments; NM_000518 top hit; bit-score ordering correct). The literal fixed megablast contract executed network-free with program='blastn', megablast=True; its live request did not complete within 300 s under the repeated CGI connection failure and was stopped. The unfixed literal program='megablast' regression raised the documented ValueError immediately.

inputs.label: 200 unknown CDS remote-BLAST boundary
inputs.execution_note: Executed current-source decision checks: >50 sequences routes to local-blast and >1000 routes to DIAMOND/MMseqs2 in remote-homology; no remote search was initiated for the deliberately out-of-scope batch.

inputs.label: RID client and missing-defline protection
inputs.execution_note: Executed current scripts/blast_rid.py with a missing-defline FASTA; it refused the input with the documented ~12x-latency warning. Its valid HBB run reached the NCBI BLAST CGI and exited cleanly with 'NCBI request failed: Remote end closed connection without response'; CLI help and polling/error branches were also exercised locally.

key_strengths: The corrected qblast API contract uses program='blastn' plus megablast/template flags rather than invalid literal program names.
The literal short-peptide reference block carries PAM30-compatible gapcosts='9 1' and the expected sensitivity parameters.
Current local parsing, result ordering, defline guard, and decision boundaries execute correctly from the pinned source.

recommendations.title: Re-run live NCBI BLAST verification when Blast.cgi accepts requests
recommendations.problem: Every fresh BLAST CGI request in this audit received a connection close without a response, including direct curl verification.
recommendations.root_cause: External NCBI BLAST CGI availability or network path; the same failure spans Biopython qblast and the stdlib RID client.
recommendations.fix: Do not change source based on this evidence alone. Re-run the four live paths when the endpoint recovers, retaining the current parameter and parser checks as corroborating evidence.
